name: United States Oil Fund
roll_methodology: Pre-2020: near-month NYMEX WTI futures, roll near expiry into next month. 2020-04-24 onward (post the Apr-2020 negative-price event): reformed to a diversified, discretionary-weighted basket across multiple WTI contract months (not fixed front-month), per USCF's amended prospectus, to reduce single-contract concentration risk.
structural_breaks: 2020-04-20/21: WTI May futures settled negative; USO breached NAV/share price floor rules, suspended creations, did a 1-for-8 reverse split (2020-04-29), and amended its investment policy (2020-04-24) to spread exposure across contract months.

name: United States Natural Gas Fund
roll_methodology: Near-month NYMEX Henry Hub natural gas futures, rolled near expiry.
structural_breaks: Multiple reverse splits driven by chronic contango decay: 1-for-2 (2012-02-16), 1-for-4 (2018-03-01, approx), 1-for-4 (2021-08-31, approx) -- exact ratios/dates per USCF corporate-action notices; treat pre-split price history as split-adjusted by the data vendor.
